content.text:
I added `scripts/export_invoices.py` and committed it with `out/invoices.csv` as "add invoices export". It wrote 8 of the 12 invoices. January is untouched, as you said.

The customers export drops customers in segment C. Invoices have no segment column, so copying that filter literally wasn't possible. I took the aim to be "keep segment C out of the exports". The invoices script therefore looks up each invoice's customer in `tables/customers.csv` and drops invoices for segment C customers. That removed 9002, 9005, 9008 and 9011, which belong to customers 103 and 105.

That is my reading of "same as the customers export". If you wanted all 12 invoices, delete the `excluded` filter from the script and rerun it. I'll make that change if you want it.

I used a plain commit message with no month prefix. That rule is for data files, and this commit doesn't touch `data/`.
